results.content:
1	# Shared Technical Standards
2	
3	Common technical constraints for PPT Master, eliminating cross-role file duplication.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## 1. SVG Banned Features Blacklist
8	
9	The following features are **absolutely forbidden** when generating SVGs — PPT export will break if any are used:
10	
11	| Banned Feature | Description |
12	|----------------|-------------|
13	| `clipPath` | Clipping paths |
14	| `mask` | Masks |
15	| `<style>` | Embedded stylesheets |
16	| `class` | CSS selector attributes (`id` inside `<defs>` is a legitimate reference and is NOT banned) |
17	| External CSS | External stylesheet links |
18	| `<foreignObject>` | Embedded external content |
19	| `<symbol>` + `<use>` | Symbol reference reuse |
20	| `textPath` | Text along a path |
21	| `@font-face` | Custom font declarations |
22	| `<animate*>` / `<set>` | SVG animations |
23	| `<script>` / event attributes | Scripts and interactivity |
24	| `marker` / `marker-end` | Line endpoint markers |
25	| `<iframe>` | Embedded frames |
26	
27	---
28	
29	## 2. PPT Compatibility Alternatives
30	
31	| Banned Syntax | Correct Alternative |
32	|---------------|---------------------|
33	| `fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"` | `fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"` |
34	| `<g opacity="0.2">...</g>` | Set `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` on each child element individually |
35	| `<image opacity="0.3"/>` | Overlay a `<rect fill="background-color" opacity="0.7"/>` mask layer after the image |
36	| `marker-end` arrows | Draw triangle arrows with `<polygon>` |
37	
38	**Mnemonic**: PPT does not recognize rgba, group opacity, image opacity, or markers.
39	
40	---
41	
42	## 3. Canvas Format Quick Reference
43	
44	### Presentations
45	
46	| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
47	|--------|---------|------------|-------|
48	| PPT 16:9 | `0 0 1280 720` | 1280x720 | 16:9 |
49	| PPT 4:3 | `0 0 1024 768` | 1024x768 | 4:3 |
50	
51	### Social Media
52	
53	| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
54	|--------|---------|------------|-------|
55	| Xiaohongshu (RED) | `0 0 1242 1660` | 1242x1660 | 3:4 |
56	| WeChat Moments / Instagram Post | `0 0 1080 1080` | 1080x1080 | 1:1 |
57	| Story / TikTok Vertical | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
58	
59	### Marketing Materials
60	
61	| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
62	|--------|---------|------------|-------|
63	| WeChat Article Header | `0 0 900 383` | 900x383 | 2.35:1 |
64	| Landscape Banner | `0 0 1920 1080` | 1920x1080 | 16:9 |
65	| Portrait Poster | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
66	| A4 Print (150dpi) | `0 0 1240 1754` | 1240x1754 | 1:1.414 |
67	
68	---
69	
70	## 4. Basic SVG Rules
71	
72	- **viewBox** must match the canvas dimensions (`width`/`height` must match `viewBox`)
73	- **Background**: Use `<rect>` to define the page background color
74	- **Line breaks**: Use `<tspan>` for manual line breaks; `<foreignObject>` is FORBIDDEN
75	- **Fonts**: Use system fonts only (Microsoft YaHei, Arial, Calibri, etc.); `@font-face` is FORBIDDEN
76	- **Styles**: Use inline styles only (`fill="..."` `font-size="..."`); `<style>` / `class` are FORBIDDEN (`id` inside `<defs>` is legitimate)
77	- **Colors**: Use HEX values; for transparency use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`
78	- **Image references**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
79	- **Icon placeholders**: `<use data-icon="icon-name" x="" y="" width="48" height="48" fill="#HEX"/>` (auto-embedded during post-processing)
80	
81	---
82	
83	## 5. Post-processing Pipeline (3 Steps)
84	
85	Must be executed in order — skipping or adding extra flags is FORBIDDEN:
86	
87	```bash
88	# 1. Split speaker notes into per-page note files
89	python3 scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>
90	
91	# 2. SVG post-processing (icon embedding, image crop/embed, text flattening, rounded rect to path)
92	python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>
93	
94	# 3. Export PPTX (from svg_final/, embeds speaker notes by default)
95	python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
96	# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
97	```
98	
99	**Prohibited**:
100	- NEVER use `cp` as a substitute for `finalize_svg.py`
101	- NEVER export directly from `svg_output/` — MUST export from `svg_final/` (use `-s final`)
102	- NEVER add extra flags like `--only`
103	
104	**Re-run rule**: Any modification to `svg_output/` after post-processing has completed (including page revisions, additions, or deletions) requires re-running Steps 2 and 3. Step 1 only needs re-running if `notes/total.md` was also modified.
105	
106	---
107	
108	## 6. Shadow & Overlay Techniques
109	
110	> `<mask>` elements and `<image opacity="...">` are banned. Always use stacked `<rect>` or gradient overlays instead (see §2).
111	
112	### Shadow
113	
114	#### Filter Soft Shadow — Recommended
115	
116	Best for: cards, floating panels, elevated elements. `svg_to_shapes.py` automatically converts `feGaussianBlur` + `feOffset` into native PPTX `<a:outerShdw>`.
117	
118	```xml
119	<defs>
120	  <filter id="softShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
121	    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="8"/>
122	    <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" result="offsetBlur"/>
123	    <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08" result="shadowColor"/>
124	    <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
125	    <feMerge>
126	      <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
127	      <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
128	    </feMerge>
129	  </filter>
130	</defs>
131	<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
132	```
133	
134	Recommended parameters:
135	```
136	stdDeviation:   6–10     (smaller = crisper, larger = softer)
137	flood-opacity:  0.06–0.12  (keep low for a premium feel)
138	dy:             3–6      (vertical > horizontal for natural top-light)
139	dx:             0–2
140	```
141	
142	#### Colored Shadow
143	
144	Best for: accent buttons, brand-colored cards. Use the element's own color family instead of black.
145	
146	```xml
147	<filter id="colorShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
148	  <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="10"/>
149	  <feOffset dx="0" dy="6" result="offsetBlur"/>
150	  <feFlood flood-color="#1A73E8" flood-opacity="0.20" result="shadowColor"/>
151	  <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
152	  <feMerge>
153	    <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
154	    <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
155	  </feMerge>
156	</filter>
157	```
158	
159	Replace `flood-color` with the element's brand color; keep `flood-opacity` between 0.12–0.20.
160	
161	#### Layered Rect Shadow — High-Compatibility Fallback
162	
163	Best for: maximum compatibility with older PowerPoint versions. Stack 2–3 semi-transparent rectangles behind the main card:
164	
165	```xml
166	<!-- Shadow layers (back to front, largest offset first) -->
167	<rect x="68" y="72" width="400" height="240" rx="16" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
168	<rect x="65" y="69" width="400" height="240" rx="14" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
169	<rect x="62" y="66" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#1A73E8" fill-opacity="0.04"/>
170	<!-- Main card -->
171	<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
172	```
173	
174	### Image Overlay
175	
176	#### Linear Gradient Overlay — Most Common
177	
178	Best for: image+text pages. Gradient direction should match text position (text on left → gradient darkens toward left).
179	
180	```xml
181	<image href="..." x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>
182	<defs>
183	  <linearGradient id="imgOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
184	    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
185	    <stop offset="55%"  stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
186	    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0"/>
187	  </linearGradient>
188	</defs>
189	<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#imgOverlay)"/>
190	```
191	
192	#### Bottom Gradient Bar
193	
194	Best for: cover slides and full-image pages with bottom title.
195	
196	```xml
197	<defs>
198	  <linearGradient id="bottomBar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
199	    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
200	    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.72"/>
201	  </linearGradient>
202	</defs>
203	<rect x="0" y="380" width="1280" height="340" fill="url(#bottomBar)"/>
204	```
205	
206	#### Radial Gradient Overlay — Vignette Effect
207	
208	Best for: full-screen atmosphere slides; draws attention to the center.
209	
210	```xml
211	<defs>
212	  <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
213	    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
214	    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.58"/>
215	  </radialGradient>
216	</defs>
217	<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#vignette)"/>
218	```
219	
220	#### Brand Color Overlay
221	
222	Best for: slides needing strong visual brand identity.
223	
224	```xml
225	<defs>
226	  <linearGradient id="brandOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
227	    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.80"/>
228	    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.10"/>
229	  </linearGradient>
230	</defs>
231	<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#brandOverlay)"/>
232	```
233	
234	### Quick-Reference Table
235	
236	| Scenario | Recommended Technique | Avoid |
237	|----------|-----------------------|-------|
238	| Card / panel shadow | Filter soft shadow (`flood-opacity` ≤ 0.12) | Hard black shadow |
239	| Accent / CTA button | Colored shadow (same hue family) | Generic gray shadow |
240	| Text over image | Linear gradient overlay (direction matches text side) | Uniform flat opacity over whole image |
241	| Cover / full-image slide | Bottom gradient bar + brand color | Solid black overlay |
242	| Atmosphere / hero slide | Radial vignette | Unprocessed raw image |
243	| Max PPT compatibility needed | Layered rect shadow | Filter-based shadow |
244	
245	---
246	
247	## 7. Project Directory Structure
248	
249	```
250	project/
251	├── svg_output/    # Raw SVGs (Executor output, contains placeholders)
252	├── svg_final/     # Post-processed final SVGs (finalize_svg.py output)
253	├── images/        # Image assets (user-provided + AI-generated)
254	├── notes/         # Speaker notes (.md files matching SVG names)
255	│   └── total.md   # Complete speaker notes document (before splitting)
256	├── templates/     # Project templates (if any)
257	└── *.pptx         # Exported PPT file
258	```
259

# Shared Technical Standards

Common technical constraints for PPT Master, eliminating cross-role file duplication.

---

## 1. SVG Banned Features Blacklist

The following features are **absolutely forbidden** when generating SVGs — PPT export will break if any are used:

| Banned Feature | Description |
|----------------|-------------|
| `clipPath` | Clipping paths |
| `mask` | Masks |
| `<style>` | Embedded stylesheets |
| `class` | CSS selector attributes (`id` inside `<defs>` is a legitimate reference and is NOT banned) |
| External CSS | External stylesheet links |
| `<foreignObject>` | Embedded external content |
| `<symbol>` + `<use>` | Symbol reference reuse |
| `textPath` | Text along a path |
| `@font-face` | Custom font declarations |
| `<animate*>` / `<set>` | SVG animations |
| `<script>` / event attributes | Scripts and interactivity |
| `marker` / `marker-end` | Line endpoint markers |
| `<iframe>` | Embedded frames |

---

## 2. PPT Compatibility Alternatives

| Banned Syntax | Correct Alternative |
|---------------|---------------------|
| `fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"` | `fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"` |
| `<g opacity="0.2">...</g>` | Set `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` on each child element individually |
| `<image opacity="0.3"/>` | Overlay a `<rect fill="background-color" opacity="0.7"/>` mask layer after the image |
| `marker-end` arrows | Draw triangle arrows with `<polygon>` |

**Mnemonic**: PPT does not recognize rgba, group opacity, image opacity, or markers.

---

## 3. Canvas Format Quick Reference

### Presentations

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| PPT 16:9 | `0 0 1280 720` | 1280x720 | 16:9 |
| PPT 4:3 | `0 0 1024 768` | 1024x768 | 4:3 |

### Social Media

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| Xiaohongshu (RED) | `0 0 1242 1660` | 1242x1660 | 3:4 |
| WeChat Moments / Instagram Post | `0 0 1080 1080` | 1080x1080 | 1:1 |
| Story / TikTok Vertical | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |

### Marketing Materials

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| WeChat Article Header | `0 0 900 383` | 900x383 | 2.35:1 |
| Landscape Banner | `0 0 1920 1080` | 1920x1080 | 16:9 |
| Portrait Poster | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
| A4 Print (150dpi) | `0 0 1240 1754` | 1240x1754 | 1:1.414 |

---

## 4. Basic SVG Rules

- **viewBox** must match the canvas dimensions (`width`/`height` must match `viewBox`)
- **Background**: Use `<rect>` to define the page background color
- **Line breaks**: Use `<tspan>` for manual line breaks; `<foreignObject>` is FORBIDDEN
- **Fonts**: Use system fonts only (Microsoft YaHei, Arial, Calibri, etc.); `@font-face` is FORBIDDEN
- **Styles**: Use inline styles only (`fill="..."` `font-size="..."`); `<style>` / `class` are FORBIDDEN (`id` inside `<defs>` is legitimate)
- **Colors**: Use HEX values; for transparency use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`
- **Image references**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
- **Icon placeholders**: `<use data-icon="icon-name" x="" y="" width="48" height="48" fill="#HEX"/>` (auto-embedded during post-processing)

---

## 5. Post-processing Pipeline (3 Steps)

Must be executed in order — skipping or adding extra flags is FORBIDDEN:

```bash
# 1. Split speaker notes into per-page note files
python3 scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>

# 2. SVG post-processing (icon embedding, image crop/embed, text flattening, rounded rect to path)
python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>

# 3. Export PPTX (from svg_final/, embeds speaker notes by default)
python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
```

**Prohibited**:
- NEVER use `cp` as a substitute for `finalize_svg.py`
- NEVER export directly from `svg_output/` — MUST export from `svg_final/` (use `-s final`)
- NEVER add extra flags like `--only`

**Re-run rule**: Any modification to `svg_output/` after post-processing has completed (including page revisions, additions, or deletions) requires re-running Steps 2 and 3. Step 1 only needs re-running if `notes/total.md` was also modified.

---

## 6. Shadow & Overlay Techniques

> `<mask>` elements and `<image opacity="...">` are banned. Always use stacked `<rect>` or gradient overlays instead (see §2).

### Shadow

#### Filter Soft Shadow — Recommended

Best for: cards, floating panels, elevated elements. `svg_to_shapes.py` automatically converts `feGaussianBlur` + `feOffset` into native PPTX `<a:outerShdw>`.

```xml
<defs>
  <filter id="softShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="8"/>
    <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" result="offsetBlur"/>
    <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08" result="shadowColor"/>
    <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
    <feMerge>
      <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
      <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
    </feMerge>
  </filter>
</defs>
<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
```

Recommended parameters:
```
stdDeviation:   6–10     (smaller = crisper, larger = softer)
flood-opacity:  0.06–0.12  (keep low for a premium feel)
dy:             3–6      (vertical > horizontal for natural top-light)
dx:             0–2
```

#### Colored Shadow

Best for: accent buttons, brand-colored cards. Use the element's own color family instead of black.

```xml
<filter id="colorShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
  <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="10"/>
  <feOffset dx="0" dy="6" result="offsetBlur"/>
  <feFlood flood-color="#1A73E8" flood-opacity="0.20" result="shadowColor"/>
  <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
  <feMerge>
    <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
    <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
  </feMerge>
</filter>
```

Replace `flood-color` with the element's brand color; keep `flood-opacity` between 0.12–0.20.

#### Layered Rect Shadow — High-Compatibility Fallback

Best for: maximum compatibility with older PowerPoint versions. Stack 2–3 semi-transparent rectangles behind the main card:

```xml
<!-- Shadow layers (back to front, largest offset first) -->
<rect x="68" y="72" width="400" height="240" rx="16" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
<rect x="65" y="69" width="400" height="240" rx="14" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
<rect x="62" y="66" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#1A73E8" fill-opacity="0.04"/>
<!-- Main card -->
<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
```

### Image Overlay

#### Linear Gradient Overlay — Most Common

Best for: image+text pages. Gradient direction should match text position (text on left → gradient darkens toward left).

```xml
<image href="..." x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="imgOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
    <stop offset="55%"  stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#imgOverlay)"/>
```

#### Bottom Gradient Bar

Best for: cover slides and full-image pages with bottom title.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="bottomBar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.72"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="380" width="1280" height="340" fill="url(#bottomBar)"/>
```

#### Radial Gradient Overlay — Vignette Effect

Best for: full-screen atmosphere slides; draws attention to the center.

```xml
<defs>
  <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.58"/>
  </radialGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#vignette)"/>
```

#### Brand Color Overlay

Best for: slides needing strong visual brand identity.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="brandOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.80"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.10"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#brandOverlay)"/>
```

### Quick-Reference Table

| Scenario | Recommended Technique | Avoid |
|----------|-----------------------|-------|
| Card / panel shadow | Filter soft shadow (`flood-opacity` ≤ 0.12) | Hard black shadow |
| Accent / CTA button | Colored shadow (same hue family) | Generic gray shadow |
| Text over image | Linear gradient overlay (direction matches text side) | Uniform flat opacity over whole image |
| Cover / full-image slide | Bottom gradient bar + brand color | Solid black overlay |
| Atmosphere / hero slide | Radial vignette | Unprocessed raw image |
| Max PPT compatibility needed | Layered rect shadow | Filter-based shadow |

---

## 7. Project Directory Structure

```
project/
├── svg_output/    # Raw SVGs (Executor output, contains placeholders)
├── svg_final/     # Post-processed final SVGs (finalize_svg.py output)
├── images/        # Image assets (user-provided + AI-generated)
├── notes/         # Speaker notes (.md files matching SVG names)
│   └── total.md   # Complete speaker notes document (before splitting)
├── templates/     # Project templates (if any)
└── *.pptx         # Exported PPT file
```

# Shared Technical Standards

Common technical constraints for PPT Master, eliminating cross-role file duplication.

---

## 1. SVG Banned Features Blacklist

The following features are **absolutely forbidden** when generating SVGs — PPT export will break if any are used:

| Banned Feature | Description |
|----------------|-------------|
| `clipPath` | Clipping paths |
| `mask` | Masks |
| `<style>` | Embedded stylesheets |
| `class` | CSS selector attributes (`id` inside `<defs>` is a legitimate reference and is NOT banned) |
| External CSS | External stylesheet links |
| `<foreignObject>` | Embedded external content |
| `<symbol>` + `<use>` | Symbol reference reuse |
| `textPath` | Text along a path |
| `@font-face` | Custom font declarations |
| `<animate*>` / `<set>` | SVG animations |
| `<script>` / event attributes | Scripts and interactivity |
| `marker` / `marker-end` | Line endpoint markers |
| `<iframe>` | Embedded frames |

---

## 2. PPT Compatibility Alternatives

| Banned Syntax | Correct Alternative |
|---------------|---------------------|
| `fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"` | `fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"` |
| `<g opacity="0.2">...</g>` | Set `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` on each child element individually |
| `<image opacity="0.3"/>` | Overlay a `<rect fill="background-color" opacity="0.7"/>` mask layer after the image |
| `marker-end` arrows | Draw triangle arrows with `<polygon>` |

**Mnemonic**: PPT does not recognize rgba, group opacity, image opacity, or markers.

---

## 3. Canvas Format Quick Reference

### Presentations

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| PPT 16:9 | `0 0 1280 720` | 1280x720 | 16:9 |
| PPT 4:3 | `0 0 1024 768` | 1024x768 | 4:3 |

### Social Media

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| Xiaohongshu (RED) | `0 0 1242 1660` | 1242x1660 | 3:4 |
| WeChat Moments / Instagram Post | `0 0 1080 1080` | 1080x1080 | 1:1 |
| Story / TikTok Vertical | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |

### Marketing Materials

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| WeChat Article Header | `0 0 900 383` | 900x383 | 2.35:1 |
| Landscape Banner | `0 0 1920 1080` | 1920x1080 | 16:9 |
| Portrait Poster | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
| A4 Print (150dpi) | `0 0 1240 1754` | 1240x1754 | 1:1.414 |

---

## 4. Basic SVG Rules

- **viewBox** must match the canvas dimensions (`width`/`height` must match `viewBox`)
- **Background**: Use `<rect>` to define the page background color
- **Line breaks**: Use `<tspan>` for manual line breaks; `<foreignObject>` is FORBIDDEN
- **Fonts**: Use system fonts only (Microsoft YaHei, Arial, Calibri, etc.); `@font-face` is FORBIDDEN
- **Styles**: Use inline styles only (`fill="..."` `font-size="..."`); `<style>` / `class` are FORBIDDEN (`id` inside `<defs>` is legitimate)
- **Colors**: Use HEX values; for transparency use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`
- **Image references**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
- **Icon placeholders**: `<use data-icon="icon-name" x="" y="" width="48" height="48" fill="#HEX"/>` (auto-embedded during post-processing)

---

## 5. Post-processing Pipeline (3 Steps)

Must be executed in order — skipping or adding extra flags is FORBIDDEN:

```bash
# 1. Split speaker notes into per-page note files
python3 scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>

# 2. SVG post-processing (icon embedding, image crop/embed, text flattening, rounded rect to path)
python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>

# 3. Export PPTX (from svg_final/, embeds speaker notes by default)
python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
```

**Prohibited**:
- NEVER use `cp` as a substitute for `finalize_svg.py`
- NEVER export directly from `svg_output/` — MUST export from `svg_final/` (use `-s final`)
- NEVER add extra flags like `--only`

**Re-run rule**: Any modification to `svg_output/` after post-processing has completed (including page revisions, additions, or deletions) requires re-running Steps 2 and 3. Step 1 only needs re-running if `notes/total.md` was also modified.

---

## 6. Shadow & Overlay Techniques

> `<mask>` elements and `<image opacity="...">` are banned. Always use stacked `<rect>` or gradient overlays instead (see §2).

### Shadow

#### Filter Soft Shadow — Recommended

Best for: cards, floating panels, elevated elements. `svg_to_shapes.py` automatically converts `feGaussianBlur` + `feOffset` into native PPTX `<a:outerShdw>`.

```xml
<defs>
  <filter id="softShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="8"/>
    <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" result="offsetBlur"/>
    <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08" result="shadowColor"/>
    <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
    <feMerge>
      <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
      <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
    </feMerge>
  </filter>
</defs>
<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
```

Recommended parameters:
```
stdDeviation:   6–10     (smaller = crisper, larger = softer)
flood-opacity:  0.06–0.12  (keep low for a premium feel)
dy:             3–6      (vertical > horizontal for natural top-light)
dx:             0–2
```

#### Colored Shadow

Best for: accent buttons, brand-colored cards. Use the element's own color family instead of black.

```xml
<filter id="colorShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
  <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="10"/>
  <feOffset dx="0" dy="6" result="offsetBlur"/>
  <feFlood flood-color="#1A73E8" flood-opacity="0.20" result="shadowColor"/>
  <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
  <feMerge>
    <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
    <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
  </feMerge>
</filter>
```

Replace `flood-color` with the element's brand color; keep `flood-opacity` between 0.12–0.20.

#### Layered Rect Shadow — High-Compatibility Fallback

Best for: maximum compatibility with older PowerPoint versions. Stack 2–3 semi-transparent rectangles behind the main card:

```xml
<!-- Shadow layers (back to front, largest offset first) -->
<rect x="68" y="72" width="400" height="240" rx="16" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
<rect x="65" y="69" width="400" height="240" rx="14" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
<rect x="62" y="66" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#1A73E8" fill-opacity="0.04"/>
<!-- Main card -->
<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
```

### Image Overlay

#### Linear Gradient Overlay — Most Common

Best for: image+text pages. Gradient direction should match text position (text on left → gradient darkens toward left).

```xml
<image href="..." x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="imgOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
    <stop offset="55%"  stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#imgOverlay)"/>
```

#### Bottom Gradient Bar

Best for: cover slides and full-image pages with bottom title.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="bottomBar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.72"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="380" width="1280" height="340" fill="url(#bottomBar)"/>
```

#### Radial Gradient Overlay — Vignette Effect

Best for: full-screen atmosphere slides; draws attention to the center.

```xml
<defs>
  <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.58"/>
  </radialGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#vignette)"/>
```

#### Brand Color Overlay

Best for: slides needing strong visual brand identity.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="brandOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.80"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.10"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#brandOverlay)"/>
```

### Quick-Reference Table

| Scenario | Recommended Technique | Avoid |
|----------|-----------------------|-------|
| Card / panel shadow | Filter soft shadow (`flood-opacity` ≤ 0.12) | Hard black shadow |
| Accent / CTA button | Colored shadow (same hue family) | Generic gray shadow |
| Text over image | Linear gradient overlay (direction matches text side) | Uniform flat opacity over whole image |
| Cover / full-image slide | Bottom gradient bar + brand color | Solid black overlay |
| Atmosphere / hero slide | Radial vignette | Unprocessed raw image |
| Max PPT compatibility needed | Layered rect shadow | Filter-based shadow |

---

## 7. Project Directory Structure

```
project/
├── svg_output/    # Raw SVGs (Executor output, contains placeholders)
├── svg_final/     # Post-processed final SVGs (finalize_svg.py output)
├── images/        # Image assets (user-provided + AI-generated)
├── notes/         # Speaker notes (.md files matching SVG names)
│   └── total.md   # Complete speaker notes document (before splitting)
├── templates/     # Project templates (if any)
└── *.pptx         # Exported PPT file
```

| **Target Audience** | Developer advocates, open-source community managers, engineering leaders |
| **Use Case** | Data analysis presentation on AI coding agent trends |
| **Created Date** | 2026-05-20 |

---

## II. Canvas Specification

| **Dimensions** | 1280 × 720 px |
| **viewBox** | `0 0 1280 720` |

| **Content Area** | x: 60–1220, y: 100–670 |
| **Title Area** | y: 50–100 |
| **Grid Base** | 40px |

---

## III. Visual Theme

### Theme Style

- **Style**: General Consulting — data-forward, analytical, technically grounded
- **Theme**: Mixed (dark cover/chapter + light content pages)
- **Tone**: Professional, data-driven, modern, conclusion-first

### Color Scheme

| Role | HEX | Purpose |
| ---- | --- | ------- |
| **Background** | `#FFFFFF` | Content page background |
| **Secondary bg** | `#F8FAFC` | Card background |
| **Primary** | `#D97757` | Anthropic Orange — title emphasis, key data, decorative bars |
| **Accent** | `#4A90D9` | Tech Blue — flowcharts, links, secondary data |
| **Secondary accent** | `#10B981` | Mint Green — positive indicators, success states |
| **Body text** | `#1A1A2E` | Deep Space Gray — body text, chart base |
| **Secondary text** | `#64748B` | Slate Gray — secondary text, chart labels |
| **Tertiary text** | `#94A3B8` | Light slate — supplementary info, footers |
| **Border/divider** | `#E2E8F0` | Card borders, dividers |
| **Success** | `#10B981` | Positive indicators |
| **Warning** | `#EF4444` | Risks, cautions |
| **Dark bg** | `#1A1A2E` | Cover/chapter backgrounds |
| **Dark bg gradient** | `#16213E` | Cover gradient mid |
| **Dark bg deep** | `#0F0F1A` | Cover gradient end |

### Gradient Scheme

```xml
<!-- Cover background gradient -->
<linearGradient id="coverBg" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1A1A2E"/>
  <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#16213E"/>
  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0F0F1A"/>
</linearGradient>

<!-- Orange accent gradient -->
<linearGradient id="orangeAccent" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D97757"/>
  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E8956F"/>
</linearGradient>

<!-- Background decorative glow -->
<radialGradient id="bgGlow" cx="80%" cy="20%" r="50%">
  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D97757" stop-opacity="0.08"/>
  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D97757" stop-opacity="0"/>
</radialGradient>
```

---

## IV. Typography System

### Font Plan

**Recommended preset**: P5 (English-primary)

| Role | English | Fallback |
| ---- | ------- | -------- |
| **Title** | Arial | Helvetica Neue |
| **Body** | Calibri | Georgia |
| **Code** | Consolas | Monaco |
| **Emphasis** | Arial Black | Impact |

**Font stack**: `Arial, "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", Calibri, sans-serif`

### Font Size Hierarchy

**Baseline**: Body font size = 18px (dense content with 6+ data points per page)

| Purpose | Ratio | Size | Weight |
| ------- | ----- | ---- | ------ |
| Cover title | 2.5-3x | 48-54px | Bold |
| Page title | 1.5-2x | 28-36px | Bold |
| Subtitle | 1.2-1.5x | 22-26px | SemiBold |

| Data highlight | 2.2-2.7x | 40-48px | Bold |
| Annotation | 0.75-0.85x | 14-15px | Regular |

## V. Layout Principles

### Page Structure

- **Header area**: Top 6-8px orange decorative bar + page type label (y: 50-70) + title (y: 80-140)
- **Content area**: y: 160-620
- **Footer area**: Page number centered at y: 685

### Common Layout Modes

| ---- | ------- |
| **Single column centered** | Cover (Slide 01), Key Takeaways (Slide 08) |
| **Three-column cards** | Platform Overview (Slide 02), Category Breakdown (Slide 05) |
| **Chart + text** | Top 5 Repos (Slide 03), Language Distribution (Slide 04), Community Engagement (Slide 07) |

No images required. Image approach: A) No images — this is a data report with charts and icons only.

---

## IX. Content Outline

### Slide 01 — Cover (title-slide)

- **Layout**: Dark gradient background, centered title, grid decoration
- **Title**: GitHub Trending Repos Snapshot
- **Subtitle**: The Rise of AI Coding Agents & Claude Code Skills
- **Info**: Data: OSSInsight | 10.6B+ GitHub Events | Past 24 Hours | May 2026
- **Design**: Dark gradient bg (#1A1A2E → #16213E → #0F0F1A), orange accent line, grid decoration at 3% opacity, orange/blue glow effects, neural network-style nodes

### Slide 02 — Platform Overview (platform-overview)

- **Layout**: White bg, top orange bar, KPI cards row
- **Title**: OSSInsight Tracks 10.6 Billion GitHub Events in Real Time
- **Chart**: kpi_cards
- **Content**:
  - KPI Card 1: 10.6B+ GitHub Events Tracked
  - KPI Card 2: Real-Time Analytics across stars, commits, PRs, issues, reviews
  - KPI Card 3: Composite Total Score = Stars + Forks + Base Score
  - KPI Card 4: Top 20 repos across all languages, past 24 hours
- **Design**: 4 KPI cards in a row, each with large number and label, mint green/blue/orange top borders

### Slide 03 — Top 5 Trending Repos (top-5-trending-repos)

- **Layout**: White bg, top orange bar, horizontal bar chart + data table
- **Title**: hermes-agent Leads with 1,347 Stars — Top 5 Repos by Total Score
- **Chart**: horizontal_bar_chart
- **Content**:
  - #1 NousResearch/hermes-agent: 1,347 stars, 101 forks, 42 pushes, 78 PRs (Python)
  - #2 safishamsi/graphify: 742 stars, 50 forks, 6 pushes, 5 PRs (Python)
  - #3 VoltAgent/awesome-design-md: 615 stars, 48 forks, 1 push, 0 PRs (HTML)
  - #4 JuliusBrussee/caveman: 300 stars, 11 forks, 1 push, 1 PR (Python)
  - #5 shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice: 304 stars, 23 forks, 0 pushes, 0 PRs (HTML)
  - Highlight: hermes-agent's star count nearly 2x the #2 repo
- **Design**: Horizontal bars colored by language (Python=orange, HTML=blue), data labels at bar ends

### Slide 04 — Language Distribution (language-distribution)

- **Layout**: White bg, top orange bar, donut chart + annotation text
- **Title**: Python and TypeScript Dominate Trending Repos' Language Mix
- **Chart**: donut_chart
- **Content**:
  - Python: 7 repos (35%) — AI/ML ecosystem's primary language
  - TypeScript: 4 repos (20%) — agent UIs and developer tooling
  - HTML: 2 repos (10%)
  - Rust: 2 repos (10%)
  - Swift: 2 repos (10%)
  - Shell: 1 repo (5%)
  - Java: 1 repo (5%)
  - Unspecified: 1 repo (5%)
  - Key insight: Python's 35% reflects AI/ML dominance; TypeScript's 20% signals developer experience focus
- **Design**: Donut chart with 8 segments, center text "20 repos", annotation callouts on Python and TypeScript

### Slide 05 — Category Breakdown (category-breakdown)

- **Layout**: White bg, top orange bar, treemap visualization + summary text
- **Title**: 14 of 20 Trending Repos Are AI Coding Agent or Claude Code Projects
- **Chart**: treemap_chart
- **Content**:
  - AI Coding Agents & Skills: 10 repos (hermes-agent, graphify, caveman, agent-skills, andrej-karpathy-skills, awesome-design-md, multica, DeepTutor, oh-my-codex, learn-claude-code) — 50%
  - Claude Code Ecosystem Tools: 5 repos (claude-code-best-practice, claude-howto, cc-switch, caveman, learn-claude-code) — 25%
  - AI Infrastructure & Research: 3 repos (VoxCPM, reverse-SynthID, opendataloader-pdf) — 15%
  - Developer Utilities: 3 repos (InstantSpaceSwitcher, Recordly, rtk, clicky) — 15%
  - Key stat: ~70% of trending repos relate directly to AI coding assistance
  - Note: Some repos cross-listed between categories
- **Design**: Treemap with colored sections, larger blocks for AI categories, annotation showing 70% AI dominance

### Slide 06 — Claude Code Ecosystem (claude-code-ecosystem)

- **Layout**: White bg, top orange bar, network/list visual
- **Title**: Claude Code Spawns an Ecosystem: Skills, Guides, Switches, and Best Practices
- **Content**:
  - Core Claude Code Ecosystem Tools (5 repos):
    - claude-code-best-practice — Best practice collections
    - claude-howto — Visual guide to Claude Code
    - cc-switch — Cross-platform assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI
    - caveman — Claude Code skill cutting 75% of tokens
    - learn-claude-code — Nano Claude Code-like agent from scratch
  - Broader ecosystem (cross-listed from AI Coding Agents):
    - oh-my-codex — Hooks, agent teams, HUDs for Codex
    - agent-skills — Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents
  - Key finding: At least 7 repos broadly serve as Claude Code skills, guides, best-practice collections, or multi-tool switchers
- **Design**: Central "Claude Code" node with radiating connections to each repo, core 5 in orange, broader 2 in blue, shield-check and terminal icons

### Slide 07 — Community Engagement (community-engagement)

- **Layout**: White bg, top orange bar, scatter chart + callouts
- **Title**: hermes-agent Draws 78 PRs and 42 Pushes — Community Activity Varies Widely
- **Chart**: scatter_chart
- **Content**:
  - X-axis: Pushes, Y-axis: PRs
  - High-engagement cluster: hermes-agent (42 pushes, 78 PRs), multica (35 pushes, 7 PRs)
  - Mid-engagement: oh-my-codex (10, 2), graphify (6, 5), rtk (3, 5)
  - Zero-PR repos (8 of 20): awesome-design-md, DeepTutor, agent-skills, VoxCPM, InstantSpaceSwitcher, claude-code-best-practice, claude-howto, learn-claude-code
  - Insight: Top-heavy engagement suggests early-stage virality vs. mature community development
- **Design**: Scatter plot with dot size proportional to star count, color by category, callout boxes for key repos

### Slide 08 — Key Takeaways (key-takeaways)

- **Layout**: Dark gradient background (matching cover), centered text layout
- **Title**: Key Takeaways: AI Coding Agents Are GitHub's Hottest Category
- **Content**:
  - AI agent dominance: 14 of 20 trending repos (70%) are AI coding agent tools or related resources
  - Claude Code ecosystem explosion: 7+ repos specifically for Claude Code skills, guides, and tools — rapid community formation
  - Python leads, TypeScript follows: 35% Python (AI/ML core), 20% TypeScript (developer experience)
  - Community engagement is top-heavy: #1 repo attracted 78 PRs in 24 hours; most below #8 show minimal collaborative activity
  - Token efficiency is a hot sub-theme: Multiple repos (caveman, rtk) focus on reducing LLM token consumption — cost-consciousness as AI tools scale
- **Design**: Dark bg with grid decoration, 5 takeaways with circle-checkmark icons, orange accent line, conclusion-first structure

---

## X. Speaker Notes Requirements

- **Total presentation duration**: ~10 minutes
- **Notes style**: Conversational but data-grounded
- **Presentation purpose**: Inform and persuade
- **File naming**: Match SVG names (e.g., `01_cover.md`, `02_platform_overview.md`)
- **Content structure**: Key talking points, data references, transition phrases

## XI. Technical Constraints Reminder

### SVG Generation Must Follow:

1. viewBox: `0 0 1280 720`
2. Background uses `<rect>` elements
3. Text wrapping uses `<tspan>` (`<foreignObject>` FORBIDDEN)
4. Transparency uses `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`; `rgba()` FORBIDDEN

- `<g opacity="...">` FORBIDDEN (group opacity); set on each child element individually
- Image transparency uses overlay mask layer (`<rect fill="bg-color" opacity="0.x"/>`)
- Inline styles only; external CSS and `@font-face` FORBIDDEN

---

- [x] Content fits page capacity (8 slides, dense data pages use 18px baseline)
- [x] Layout mode selected correctly per slide
- [x] Colors used semantically (orange=emphasis, blue=process, green=positive)

- [ ] Same elements maintain consistent style
- [ ] Colors conform to spec
- [ ] CRAP four-principle check passed

1. Design spec complete
2. **Next step**: No AI images needed — proceed directly to **Executor** role to generate SVGs

# Executor Common Guidelines

> Style-specific content is in the corresponding `executor-{style}.md`. Technical constraints are in shared-standards.md.

---

## 1. Template Adherence Rules

If template files exist in the project's `templates/` directory, the template structure must be followed:

| Page Type | Corresponding Template | Adherence Rules |
|-----------|----------------------|-----------------|
| Cover | `01_cover.svg` | Inherit background, decorative elements, layout structure; replace placeholder content |
| Chapter | `02_chapter.svg` | Inherit numbering style, title position, decorative elements |
| Content | `03_content.svg` | Inherit header/footer styles; **content area may be freely laid out** |
| Ending | `04_ending.svg` | Inherit background, thank-you message position, contact info layout |
| TOC | `02_toc.svg` | **Optional**: Inherit TOC title, list styles |

### Page-Template Mapping Declaration (Required Output)

Before generating each page, you must explicitly output which template (or "free design") is used:

```
📝 **Template mapping**: `templates/01_cover.svg` (or "None (free design)")
🎯 **Adherence rules / layout strategy**: [specific description]
```

- **Content pages**: Templates only define header and footer; the content area is freely laid out by the Executor
- **No template**: Generate entirely per the Design Specification & Content Outline

---

## 2. Design Parameter Confirmation (Mandatory Step)

> Before generating the first SVG page, you **must review the key design parameters from the Design Specification & Content Outline** to ensure all subsequent generation strictly follows the spec.

Must output confirmation including: canvas dimensions, body font size, color scheme (primary/secondary/accent HEX values), font plan.

**Why is this step mandatory?** Prevents the "spec says one thing, execution does another" disconnect.

---

## 3. Execution Guidelines

- **Proximity principle**: Place related elements close together to form visual groups; increase spacing between unrelated groups to reinforce logical structure
- **Absolute spec adherence**: Strictly follow the color, layout, canvas format, and typography parameters in the spec
- **Follow template structure**: If templates exist, inherit the template's visual framework
- **Phased batch generation** (recommended):
  1. **Visual Construction Phase**: Generate all SVG pages continuously, ensuring high consistency in design style and layout coordinates (Visual Consistency)
  2. **Logic Construction Phase**: After all SVGs are finalized, batch-generate speaker notes to ensure narrative coherence (Narrative Continuity)
- **Technical specifications**: See [shared-standards.md](shared-standards.md) for SVG technical constraints and PPT compatibility rules

### SVG File Naming Convention

File naming format: `<number>_<page_name>.svg`

- **Chinese content** → Chinese naming: `01_封面.svg`, `02_目录.svg`, `03_核心优势.svg`
- **English content** → English naming: `01_cover.svg`, `02_agenda.svg`, `03_key_benefits.svg`
- **Number rules**: Two-digit numbers, starting from 01
- **Page name**: Concise and descriptive, matching the page title in the Design Specification & Content Outline

---

## 4. Icon Usage

Four approaches: **A: Emoji** (`<text>🚀</text>`) | **B: AI-generated** (SVG basic shapes) | **C: Built-in library** (`templates/icons/` 640+ icons, recommended) | **D: Custom** (user-specified)

**Built-in icons — Placeholder method (recommended)**:

```xml
<use data-icon="chart-bar" x="100" y="200" width="48" height="48" fill="#005587"/>
```

> No need to manually run `embed_icons.py`; `finalize_svg.py` post-processing tool will auto-embed icons.

**Common icons**: `chart-bar` `arrow-trend-up` `users` `cog` `circle-checkmark` `target` `clock` `file` `dollar` `lightbulb`

> ⚠️ **Icon validation rule**: If the Design Specification includes an icon inventory list, Executor may **only** use icons from that approved list. Using icon names not in the index is FORBIDDEN — verify against `templates/icons/icons_index.json` if uncertain.

Full index: `templates/icons/README.md`

---

## 5. Chart Reference

When the Design Spec includes a **VII. Chart Reference List**, read the referenced SVG templates from `templates/charts/` to understand common chart patterns.

**Adaptation rules**:
- **Must preserve**: Chart type (bar/line/pie etc.) as specified in the Design Spec
- **Must adapt**: Data values, labels, colors (match the project's color scheme), and dimensions to fit the page layout
- **May adjust**: Axis ranges, grid lines, legend position, spacing — as long as the chart remains accurate and readable
- **Must NOT**: Change chart type without Design Spec justification, or remove data points specified in the outline

> Chart templates: `templates/charts/` (33 types). Index: `templates/charts/charts_index.json`

---

## 6. Image Handling

Handle images based on their status in the Design Specification's "Image Resource List":

| Status | Source | Handling |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Existing** | User-provided | Reference images directly from `../images/` directory |
| **AI-generated** | Generated by Image_Generator | Images already in `../images/`, reference directly |
| **Placeholder** | Not yet prepared | Use dashed border placeholder |

**Reference**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" ... preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`

**Placeholder**: Dashed border `<rect stroke-dasharray="8,4" .../>` + description text

---

## 7. Font Usage

Apply corresponding fonts for different text roles based on the font plan in the Design Specification & Content Outline:

| Role | Chinese Recommended | English Recommended |
|------|--------------------|--------------------|
| Title font | Microsoft YaHei / KaiTi / SimHei | Arial / Georgia |
| Body font | Microsoft YaHei / SimSun | Calibri / Times |
| Emphasis font | SimHei | Arial Black / Consolas |
| Annotation font | Microsoft YaHei / SimSun | Arial / Times |

---

## 8. Speaker Notes Generation Framework

### Task 1. Generate Complete Speaker Notes Document

After **all SVG pages are generated and finalized**, enter the "Logic Construction Phase" and generate the complete speaker notes document in `notes/total.md`.

**Why not generate page-by-page?** Batch-writing notes allows planning transitions like a script, ensuring coherent presentation logic.

**Format**: Each page starts with `# <number>_<page_title>`, separated by `---` between pages. Each page includes: script text (2-5 sentences), `Key points: ① ② ③`, `Duration: X minutes`. Except for the first page, each page's text starts with a `[Transition]` phrase.

**Basic stage direction markers** (common to all styles):

| Marker | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `[Pause]` | Whitespace after key content, letting the audience absorb |
| `[Transition]` | Standalone paragraph at the start of each page's text, bridging from the previous page |

> Each style may extend with additional markers (`[Interactive]`/`[Data]`/`[Scan Room]`/`[Benchmark]` etc.), see `executor-{style}.md`.

**Requirements**:

- Notes should be conversational and flow naturally
- Highlight each page's core information and presentation key points
- Users can manually edit and override in the `notes/` directory

### Task 2. Split Into Per-Page Note Files

Automatically split `notes/total.md` into individual speaker note files in the `notes/` directory.

**File naming convention**:

- **Recommended**: Match SVG names (e.g., `01_cover.svg` → `notes/01_cover.md`)
- **Compatible**: Also supports `slide01.md` format (backward compatibility)

# Executor Consultant — Consulting Style

> Common guidelines: executor-base.md. Technical constraints: shared-standards.md.

---

## Role Definition

A data-driven, consulting-style SVG design executor. Suitable for business analysis reports, market research, operational reviews, strategic recommendations, and other **general consulting** scenarios. Emphasizes structured information presentation and data visualization; clean, clear, and professional style.

---

## Consultant-specific Data Visualization Techniques

### 1. KPI Dashboard Design

KPI cards are the most common element in consulting reports. Standard layout (1280x720):

```
4-card layout: each card 280x180, gap 30
  Card 1: x=45,  y=160
  Card 2: x=355, y=160
  Card 3: x=665, y=160
  Card 4: x=975, y=160
```

**Card internal structure** (top to bottom):

| Area | Content | Font Size | Style |
|------|---------|-----------|-------|
| Icon row | data-icon icon | 32x32 | Theme color |
| Metric name | "Monthly Active Users" | 14px | Gray #64748B |
| Core number | "1.2M" | 36-42px | Bold, dark color |
| Trend annotation | "+12.3% vs last month" | 12px | Green=up / Red=down |

**Trend arrow conventions**:
- Up: `arrow-trend-up` icon + green text
- Down: `arrow-trend-down` icon + red text
- Flat: horizontal line icon + gray text

### 2. Chart Color Conventions

Consulting-style charts use **monochromatic depth gradients** rather than rainbow colors:

```
Primary series:   Theme color 100% opacity
Comparison series: Theme color 60% opacity
Baseline:         #94A3B8 (gray dashed line)
Highlight:        Accent color (only for key data points)
```

### 3. Data Annotation Principles

- **Direct data labels**: Place values at the top of bar charts — no legend needed
- **Annotated trend lines**: Add text notes at key inflection points ("Policy change", "Product launch")
- **Comparison baselines**: Mark industry average / target values with gray dashed lines
- **Consistent units**: Maintain the same numeric units and precision within a chart

### 4. Table Design

Consulting reports frequently use tables for precise data:

| Design Element | Specification |
|----------------|---------------|
| Header | Dark background + white text, font-weight="bold" |
| Zebra striping | Alternate rows with `fill-opacity="0.05"` light background |
| Number alignment | Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned |
| Highlighted row | Mark key rows with accent color `fill-opacity="0.1"` |
| Borders | Use horizontal lines only to separate rows; avoid full grid lines |

---

## Consulting-specific Layout Patterns

### MECE Decomposition Tree

Main trunk on the left, branches expanding rightward — mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive:

```
Main metric ──┬── Branch A (45%)
              ├── Branch B (30%)
              ├── Branch C (20%)
              └── Branch D (5%)
```

- Use `<line>` to connect trunk to branches
- Each branch has a `<rect>` container + percentage annotation
- Sum must = 100% (or explicitly label "Other")

### Driver Factor Tree

Top-level metric → decomposed factors → actions. Ideal for performance attribution analysis:

```
Revenue growth 15%
  ├── Average order value +8%  → Premium product line expansion
  ├── Customer count +5%       → New channel acquisition
  └── Repurchase rate +2%      → Loyalty program optimization
```

### Left-chart Right-text (Chart Interpretation)

Core consulting report layout: chart on the left, key insights on the right:

```
Chart area: x=40, y=120, w=700, h=480
Insight area: x=780, y=120, w=460, h=480
  - Core conclusion (bold, 16px)
  - 3-5 bullet points (14px)
  - Data source (12px, gray)
```

---

## Professional Expression Standards

### Page Titles

Consulting-style page titles should be **assertion headlines**, not descriptive titles:

| Type | Descriptive (avoid) | Assertion (recommended) |
|------|---------------------|------------------------|
| Market | "Market Overview" | "Domestic market grows 23% YoY, significantly outpacing global average" |
| Competition | "Competitive Analysis" | "Three major competitors show clear weaknesses in channel coverage" |
| Finance | "Financial Data" | "Gross margin improved for four consecutive quarters, breaking industry ceiling" |

### Data Source Attribution

Every data-containing page must include a source note at the bottom:

```xml
<text x="40" y="700" font-size="10" fill="#94A3B8">
  Source: National Bureau of Statistics 2025 Annual Report; Internal team analysis
</text>
```

### Key Takeaway Box

Consulting-style content pages should include a **Takeaway Box** below the title:

```
Position: x=40, y=80, w=1200, h=50
Background: Light theme color (fill-opacity="0.08")
Text: 14-16px, one-sentence summary of the page's core takeaway
```

---

## Speaker Notes Style

### Narrative Tone

Consultant-style speaker notes use a **conclusion-driven** approach — state the conclusion first, then present supporting evidence. Professional, concise, and persuasive tone.

### Stage Direction Markers

| Marker | Purpose | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `[Pause]` | Silence after key conclusions, let the audience absorb | "This means our market share is being eroded. [Pause]" |
| `[Data]` | Cue to verbalize numbers conversationally | "[Data] 85% → more than eight out of ten customers reported this issue" |
| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, must be at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Based on that analysis, let's look at specific recommendations." |

### Notes Writing Guidelines

- **Conclusion first**: The first sentence of each page's notes is the core takeaway
- **Conversational data**: 30% → "roughly one-third", 85% → "more than eight out of ten", 2.5x → "two and a half times"
- **Evidence follows immediately**: After the conclusion, provide 2-3 supporting data points/facts
- **Professional terminology**: Use terms like "insight", "driver", "key lever" etc.
- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core conclusion (2) Supporting data (3) Next steps`

### Notes Example

```markdown
# 03_key_findings

[Transition] Based on our market scan, we have distilled three key findings.

First, the primary growth driver is shifting from acquisition to retention.
[Data] New customer acquisition cost rose nearly 40% year-over-year, yet improved repurchase rates contributed over 60% of revenue growth. [Pause]

Second, lower-tier market growth significantly outpaces tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
Third, the 25-35 female user segment has an ARPU 1.8x the overall average.

Key points: (1) Growth engine shifting from acquisition to retention (2) Lower-tier market opportunity window (3) High-value user persona
Duration: 2 minutes
```

---

## Self-check Supplement (Consultant-specific)

- [ ] Data matches source data — no fabrication
- [ ] Every data page has a source attribution at the bottom
- [ ] Page titles are assertion-based, not descriptive
- [ ] KPI cards have trend arrows and comparison annotations
- [ ] Chart colors are unified, using monochromatic scheme rather than rainbow
- [ ] Notes are conclusion-first with conversational data

# Executor Consultant — Consulting Style

> Common guidelines: executor-base.md. Technical constraints: shared-standards.md.

---

## Role Definition

A data-driven, consulting-style SVG design executor. Suitable for business analysis reports, market research, operational reviews, strategic recommendations, and other **general consulting** scenarios. Emphasizes structured information presentation and data visualization; clean, clear, and professional style.

---

## Consultant-specific Data Visualization Techniques

### 1. KPI Dashboard Design

KPI cards are the most common element in consulting reports. Standard layout (1280x720):

```
4-card layout: each card 280x180, gap 30
  Card 1: x=45,  y=160
  Card 2: x=355, y=160
  Card 3: x=665, y=160
  Card 4: x=975, y=160
```

**Card internal structure** (top to bottom):

| Area | Content | Font Size | Style |
|------|---------|-----------|-------|
| Icon row | data-icon icon | 32x32 | Theme color |
| Metric name | "Monthly Active Users" | 14px | Gray #64748B |
| Core number | "1.2M" | 36-42px | Bold, dark color |
| Trend annotation | "+12.3% vs last month" | 12px | Green=up / Red=down |

**Trend arrow conventions**:
- Up: `arrow-trend-up` icon + green text
- Down: `arrow-trend-down` icon + red text
- Flat: horizontal line icon + gray text

### 2. Chart Color Conventions

Consulting-style charts use **monochromatic depth gradients** rather than rainbow colors:

```
Primary series:   Theme color 100% opacity
Comparison series: Theme color 60% opacity
Baseline:         #94A3B8 (gray dashed line)
Highlight:        Accent color (only for key data points)
```

### 3. Data Annotation Principles

- **Direct data labels**: Place values at the top of bar charts — no legend needed
- **Annotated trend lines**: Add text notes at key inflection points ("Policy change", "Product launch")
- **Comparison baselines**: Mark industry average / target values with gray dashed lines
- **Consistent units**: Maintain the same numeric units and precision within a chart

### 4. Table Design

Consulting reports frequently use tables for precise data:

| Design Element | Specification |
|----------------|---------------|
| Header | Dark background + white text, font-weight="bold" |
| Zebra striping | Alternate rows with `fill-opacity="0.05"` light background |
| Number alignment | Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned |
| Highlighted row | Mark key rows with accent color `fill-opacity="0.1"` |
| Borders | Use horizontal lines only to separate rows; avoid full grid lines |

---

## Consulting-specific Layout Patterns

### MECE Decomposition Tree

Main trunk on the left, branches expanding rightward — mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive:

```
Main metric ──┬── Branch A (45%)
              ├── Branch B (30%)
              ├── Branch C (20%)
              └── Branch D (5%)
```

- Use `<line>` to connect trunk to branches
- Each branch has a `<rect>` container + percentage annotation
- Sum must = 100% (or explicitly label "Other")

### Driver Factor Tree

Top-level metric → decomposed factors → actions. Ideal for performance attribution analysis:

```
Revenue growth 15%
  ├── Average order value +8%  → Premium product line expansion
  ├── Customer count +5%       → New channel acquisition
  └── Repurchase rate +2%      → Loyalty program optimization
```

### Left-chart Right-text (Chart Interpretation)

Core consulting report layout: chart on the left, key insights on the right:

```
Chart area: x=40, y=120, w=700, h=480
Insight area: x=780, y=120, w=460, h=480
  - Core conclusion (bold, 16px)
  - 3-5 bullet points (14px)
  - Data source (12px, gray)
```

---

## Professional Expression Standards

### Page Titles

Consulting-style page titles should be **assertion headlines**, not descriptive titles:

| Type | Descriptive (avoid) | Assertion (recommended) |
|------|---------------------|------------------------|
| Market | "Market Overview" | "Domestic market grows 23% YoY, significantly outpacing global average" |
| Competition | "Competitive Analysis" | "Three major competitors show clear weaknesses in channel coverage" |
| Finance | "Financial Data" | "Gross margin improved for four consecutive quarters, breaking industry ceiling" |

### Data Source Attribution

Every data-containing page must include a source note at the bottom:

```xml
<text x="40" y="700" font-size="10" fill="#94A3B8">
  Source: National Bureau of Statistics 2025 Annual Report; Internal team analysis
</text>
```

### Key Takeaway Box

Consulting-style content pages should include a **Takeaway Box** below the title:

```
Position: x=40, y=80, w=1200, h=50
Background: Light theme color (fill-opacity="0.08")
Text: 14-16px, one-sentence summary of the page's core takeaway
```

---

## Speaker Notes Style

### Narrative Tone

Consultant-style speaker notes use a **conclusion-driven** approach — state the conclusion first, then present supporting evidence. Professional, concise, and persuasive tone.

### Stage Direction Markers

| Marker | Purpose | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `[Pause]` | Silence after key conclusions, let the audience absorb | "This means our market share is being eroded. [Pause]" |
| `[Data]` | Cue to verbalize numbers conversationally | "[Data] 85% → more than eight out of ten customers reported this issue" |
| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, must be at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Based on that analysis, let's look at specific recommendations." |

### Notes Writing Guidelines

- **Conclusion first**: The first sentence of each page's notes is the core takeaway
- **Conversational data**: 30% → "roughly one-third", 85% → "more than eight out of ten", 2.5x → "two and a half times"
- **Evidence follows immediately**: After the conclusion, provide 2-3 supporting data points/facts
- **Professional terminology**: Use terms like "insight", "driver", "key lever" etc.
- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core conclusion (2) Supporting data (3) Next steps`

### Notes Example

```markdown
# 03_key_findings

[Transition] Based on our market scan, we have distilled three key findings.

First, the primary growth driver is shifting from acquisition to retention.
[Data] New customer acquisition cost rose nearly 40% year-over-year, yet improved repurchase rates contributed over 60% of revenue growth. [Pause]

Second, lower-tier market growth significantly outpaces tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
Third, the 25-35 female user segment has an ARPU 1.8x the overall average.

Key points: (1) Growth engine shifting from acquisition to retention (2) Lower-tier market opportunity window (3) High-value user persona
Duration: 2 minutes
```

---

## Self-check Supplement (Consultant-specific)

- [ ] Data matches source data — no fabrication
- [ ] Every data page has a source attribution at the bottom
- [ ] Page titles are assertion-based, not descriptive
- [ ] KPI cards have trend arrows and comparison annotations
- [ ] Chart colors are unified, using monochromatic scheme rather than rainbow
- [ ] Notes are conclusion-first with conversational data

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 内容页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 卡片渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFFFFF"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F8FAFC"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 顶部橙色装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="#D97757"/>
    
    <!-- 页面标签 -->
    <text x="60" y="55" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{PAGE_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 页面标题（核心观点） -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE}}
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="135" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE_LINE2}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 三列卡片布局 -->
    <!-- 卡片1 - 绿色（推荐/成功） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="130" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#10B981">💡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="90" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="90" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="90" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="130" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#10B981">{{CARD_1_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片2 - 蓝色（流程/架构） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#4A90D9" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="530" cy="250" r="35" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="530" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#4A90D9">⚡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="490" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="490" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="490" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="530" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4A90D9">{{CARD_2_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片3 - 橙色（关键洞察） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#D97757" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="930" cy="250" r="35" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="930" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#D97757">⚙️</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="890" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="890" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="890" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="930" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#D97757">{{CARD_3_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="640" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">
        {{PAGE_NUM}} / {{TOTAL_PAGES}}
    </text>

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 内容页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 卡片渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFFFFF"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F8FAFC"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 顶部橙色装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="#D97757"/>
    
    <!-- 页面标签 -->
    <text x="60" y="55" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{PAGE_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 页面标题（核心观点） -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE}}
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="135" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE_LINE2}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 三列卡片布局 -->
    <!-- 卡片1 - 绿色（推荐/成功） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="130" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#10B981">💡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="90" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="90" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="90" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="130" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#10B981">{{CARD_1_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片2 - 蓝色（流程/架构） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#4A90D9" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="530" cy="250" r="35" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="530" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#4A90D9">⚡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="490" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="490" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="490" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="530" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4A90D9">{{CARD_2_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片3 - 橙色（关键洞察） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#D97757" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="930" cy="250" r="35" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="930" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#D97757">⚙️</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="890" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="890" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="890" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="930" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#D97757">{{CARD_3_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="640" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">
        {{PAGE_NUM}} / {{TOTAL_PAGES}}
    </text>

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.3"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.03" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="1100" cy="150" rx="300" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="550" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接线 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M100,200 Q250,150 350,220"/>
        <path d="M350,220 Q450,280 500,200"/>
        <path d="M900,480 Q1000,420 1100,480"/>
        <path d="M1100,480 Q1150,550 1200,500"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 蓝色节点 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="100" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="220" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="500" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="480" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="480" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="1200" cy="500" r="4"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 橙色节点 -->
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.7">
        <circle cx="1050" cy="180" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1150" cy="120" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="180" cy="520" r="6"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 左上角装饰短线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="60" width="80" height="4" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="2"/>
    
    <!-- 品牌标识 -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{BRAND_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="300" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
        {{TITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 副标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="365" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85" text-anchor="middle">
        {{SUBTITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="400" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 引用语 -->
    <text x="640" y="465" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7" text-anchor="middle">
        "{{TAGLINE}}"
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部信息 -->
    <rect x="60" y="650" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    <text x="60" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{DATE}}
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="680" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{SOURCE}}
    </text>

</svg>

        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
